zh: 新增一键更新：无需复制链接或手动卸载，保留模型、画质、尺寸、代理配置和密钥引用。
下载后校验 SHA-256、版本与兼容性，安装失败时尝试恢复本地旧版包。
更新进度独立显示，生图时不能更新，重复点击不会重复安装。
核对实际加载版本；必要时提示完整重启 DSH，不自动重启。1.7.1 及更早版本需先安装本版一次。
en: Adds one-click updates without copying links or manual removal, retaining model, quality, size, proxy settings and credential references.
Verifies SHA-256, package version and compatibility before installation, and attempts local rollback on failure.
Progress survives plugin replacement; active image requests and duplicate installations are protected.
Checks the actually loaded version and requests a full DSH restart only when needed. Versions up to 1.7.1 require one manual upgrade to this release.
